description_pt: Whenever you are the target of a ranged attack or a ranged touch attack, you can cast this spell to deflect the attack toward another target within 30 feet. Use the same attack roll. If the redirected attack hits the new target, resolve it as normal. Otherwise, the attack fails. If you extend the casting time to 1 full round, the duration changes from instantaneous to 1 round per caster level.

description_pt: With a touch, you give a target a powerful motivation to avoid failure. If the target is captured by non-evil creatures or is slain, his body dissolves into foul sludge. The target is utterly destroyed and cannot be affected by any spell or effect that restores life (such as true resurrection) or a semblance of life short of miracle or wish. When the target dissolves, all creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a Fortitude save against the spell's DC or become nauseated for 1d4 rounds. Material Component: Dung from an evil creature.

description_pt: You cause the subject to believe he has sustained a terrible and debilitating injury. The subject must make an initial Will save to disbelieve the phantasm. If the save fails, the subject believes he is disabled and can take only a single move action or standard action each round (strenuous activity causes 1 point of damage). In addition, each round the subject takes 1d4 points of nonlethal damage. A successful Fortitude save halves the duration of the effect.
defense: Will disbelief, then Fortitude partial; see text

description_pt: You create a ring of molten lava that erupts from the ground. Any creature in the area when the spell is cast takes 10d6 points of fire damage (Reflex half). Material Component: A piece of volcanic rock and a pinch of sulfur.

description_pt: Your touch causes a creature to collapse into a spongy mass of shifting tissue, taking 1 point of Wisdom drain each round the form is maintained. Each round as a free action, the target can attempt a new Fortitude save to regain its normal form. Material Component: Violet slime.

description_pt: You draw life force from a willing minion or ally to empower yourself. The subject takes 1d10 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum 1d10+15).
